name: Magnolia plant detector

input.name: images
input.preprocessing: RGB, letterbox to 640x640 with pad=114, divide by 255, NCHW

output.name: output0
output.format: cx,cy,width,height,class_probability; pixel coordinates in letterboxed input; no objectness channel

limitations: Same-nursery sequential-frame split, not independent-field validation.
All source JPEGs truncated; evaluated only on recovered top crops.
Precision/recall are Ultralytics validation metrics; count MAE uses fixed 0.15 confidence.
Bounding boxes provide counts and box coverage, not leaf/canopy segmentation or physical area.
